title: True hybrid retrieval (fusion + rerank + maintenance controller)
repo_context: Extend retrieval orchestration to fuse lexical+semantic, optionally rerank, and add an explicit maintenance controller without changing existing hybrid(provenance) semantics.

stories.title: Add fusion merge helper for multi-lane candidates
acceptance_criteria: New fusion helper in `backend/retrieval/engine/merge.py` merges per-lane top-K, dedupes by card id, and returns deterministic ordering
Unit tests cover per-lane caps, dedupe behavior, and stable ordering
stories.notes: Keep the helper generic; avoid changing EvidenceCard schema. Use a fixed lane order (lexical.raw, lexical.normalized, semantic) and stable tie-breakers.

stories.title: Add hybrid_semantic lane to RetrievalEngine
acceptance_criteria: `RetrievalEngine.search(... lanes=["hybrid_semantic"])` runs lexical.raw, lexical.normalized, and semantic, then returns a unified candidate list
Debug output includes per-lane diagnostics and fusion config
stories.notes: Use the fusion helper and add a new config struct if needed. Keep ordering deterministic per PRD policy.

stories.title: Add hybrid_semantic tool wrapper
acceptance_criteria: New tool wrapper calls engine with lanes=["hybrid_semantic"] and adds standard debug metadata
Tools __init__ exports the new wrapper and dispatch tests cover it

stories.title: Wire optional rerank stage into RetrievalEngine
acceptance_criteria: Rerank is invoked only when explicitly enabled (filters.extra or lanes config), and does not run by default
Rerank reorders cards and annotates provenance/debug without changing EvidenceCard shape
Tests verify rerank gating and ordering
stories.notes: Primary toggle: filters.extra["rerank"] == True. Prefer using EvidenceSpan.preview; avoid read-service calls unless bounded.

stories.title: Add retrieval maintenance controller (orchestration-only)
acceptance_criteria: Maintenance controller reports missing/stale/compact-needed actions without mutating state when dry_run=True
Controller can execute build/rebuild/compact via existing primitives when dry_run=False
Tests cover decision outputs and dry-run safety
stories.notes: Keep policy explicit and avoid implicit rebuilds on query paths. Controller must not be called from RetrievalEngine.search().

stories.title: Lexical v0+ scoring improvements (non-BM25)
acceptance_criteria: Lexical lane scores reflect match density/proximity and remain deterministic
Tests validate scoring order and do not change existing match fidelity
stories.notes: No BM25/FTS; keep scoring lightweight and explainable. Preserve EvidenceCard.id format and match offsets.
